name: Tetrahydrocannabinol
summary: Tetrahydrocannabinol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: The actions of Δ9-THC result from its partial agonist activity at the cannabinoid receptor CB1 (Ki = 40.7 nM), located mainly in the central nervous system, and the CB2 receptor (Ki = 36 nM), mainly expressed in cells of the immune system.

uses.text: THC, also known pharmaceutically as dronabinol, is used medically to relieve chemotherapy-induced nausea and HIV/AIDS-related anorexia. Nabiximols, a botanical drug which contains THC, is used medically to treat symptoms of multiple sclerosis, including spasticity and neuropathic pain.
uses.recreational: THC is widely used as a recreational drug, both by itself or with other cannabinoids like cannabidiol (CBD) or in the form of cannabis. It is the main psychoactive constituent in cannabis. The effects of THC include euphoria, appetite stimulation, sedation, cognitive and memory impairment, pain relief, anxiety, and reduced body temperature.

sideEffects.text: Side effects include red eyes, dry mouth, drowsiness, memory impairment, anxiety, and, with chronic use, cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome.

summaryZh: 四氫大麻酚（Tetrahydrocannabinol，簡稱THC），又稱Δ9-四氫大麻酚、Δ1-THC（根據舊命名法），為大麻素之一，是大麻中的主要精神活性物質。
summaryZhHans: 四氢大麻酚（Tetrahydrocannabinol，简称THC），又称Δ9-四氢大麻酚、Δ1-THC（根据旧命名法），为大麻素之一，是大麻中的主要精神活性物质。

fact.en: THC was first isolated and its structure worked out in 1964 by Raphael Mechoulam and Yechiel Gaoni in Israel. The living plant makes it mostly as THCA, an acid that turns into THC when heated.
fact.zh: 四氫大麻酚在1964年由以色列的拉斐爾．梅舒朗與葉海爾．加歐尼首次分離並解出結構。活的大麻植物主要是以THCA的形式製造它，這種酸受熱後才會轉變成THC。
fact.zhHans: 四氢大麻酚在1964年由以色列的拉斐尔．梅舒朗与叶海尔．加欧尼首次分离并解出结构。活的大麻植物主要是以THCA的形式制造它，这种酸受热后才会转变成THC。
